name: audit-audit
description: Judge whether an audit instruction is appropriate; returns a final review statement with the points that need your decision.

interface.shortDescription: Judge whether an audit instruction is appropriate
interface.longDescription: Audits the audit itself. Reaches an initial conclusion, has it reviewed by a reviewer pane when herdrpowers is installed, and returns a final review statement whose closing section names the points that require judgment so the decision stays yours. Prose is kept to the bare minimum under the artful-simplicity rule.
defaultPrompt: Judge the review criteria in this prompt before I run it.
Audit the audit instructions in AUDIT.md.
